inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL CTE aggregates monthly account activity, then self-joins the monthly result and uses PERIOD_DIFF to retain consecutive months.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored PERIOD_DIFF scalar projection, isolating function evaluation and integer metadata from the original CTE, grouping, and self-join.

fixture_notes: Two fixed YYYYMM literals isolate the one-month difference result 1 and its integer metadata.
determinism_notes: The scalar periods are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
